summary: American Clean Resources Group filed an 8-K reporting the departures and role transitions of three fractional executives: Michael Raabe (fractional COO to support role effective Feb 2, 2026), C. Derek Campbell (fractional CSO to non-executive advisor effective Jan 30, 2026), and Kelly Marshall (fractional CMO departed Apr 15, 2026). The filing also discloses a new engagement of Jeff Bootes (no role specified). No financial terms, consideration, or premiums are stated. The board did not provide a recommendation or name advisors. These are voluntary operational realignments, not a contested departure. Watch for potential strategic shifts or leadership instability.
